description: This file contains database interaction logic for storing, updating, querying, and managing execution records within a storage system for an agent-based workflow platform. It includes functions for CRUD operations on execution data, calculating run summaries, handling time parsing, and marking stale executions as timed out.

classes.name: execDepthInfo
classes.description: Helper struct to hold execution ID and parent execution ID, used for depth calculation in workflows.

methods.name: computeMaxDepth
methods.description: Calculates the maximum depth in a hierarchy of executions based on parent-child relationships.

methods.name: assignTimeValue
methods.description: Assigns a parsed time.Time value to a destination pointer, handling various database representations.

methods.name: parseDBTime
methods.description: Parses different string and time formats returned by databases into a normalized UTC time.Time.

methods.name: parseTimeString
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into time.Time using various supported layouts, handling different timestamp formats.
